description: This Java source file defines the class WebShoppingCart, which extends the ShoppingCart class to add web session-specific functionality for an order shopping cart in the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles request and session data to initialize cart properties pertinent to user sessions in an e-commerce context.

classes.name: WebShoppingCart
classes.description: An extension of ShoppingCart that provides web presentation layer functionalities tied to the user session, facilitating the creation and management of shopping cart instances within a servlet-based web environment.

methods.name: WebShoppingCart(HttpServletRequest, Locale, String)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebShoppingCart with request parameters, locale, and currency, setting user login info and order party ID from session attributes.

methods.name: WebShoppingCart(HttpServletRequest)
methods.description: Convenience constructor that obtains locale and currency UOM from the request using utility methods.

methods.name: WebShoppingCart(ShoppingCart)
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new WebShoppingCart as a clone of an existing ShoppingCart instance.
